environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) a custom rule group with a RegexPatternSet matching on query string parameters using pattern `(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+select|select[\s/\*]+(?:.*?from)|(?:--|#|/\*).*?(?:select|union|insert|update|delete|drop)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\w+['"]?\s*[=<>])` with action BLOCK and priority 1, and (2) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 10 with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule overridden to COUNT. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress policy (tasks can reach the internet), and CloudWatch logging is enabled on the WAF with sampled requests visible. The container runs as non-root (uid 1000) with a read-only root filesystem except /var/app/data which is an EFS mount.

config.load_balancer: ALBv2 with HTTPS listener (ACM cert), target group health check on /health
config.security_group: inbound from ALB SG only on port 8080
config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway for egress
